name: V-Up
steps: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your legs extended straight together and your arms stretched straight overhead.
Brace your abs firmly to press your lower back toward the ground.
Lift your legs and torso together and reach your fingertips toward your toes as you balance in a V.
Lower your torso, arms, and legs slowly back down under full control just short of resting on the floor.
tips: Avoid jerking your neck forward; initiate the lift by contracting your abs tightly.
Soften your knees slightly if tight hamstrings prevent you from lifting smoothly.
